name: Jerome
summary: A copper-boom town that nearly died and came back as an artsy 'ghost town' clinging to a mountainside above the Verde Valley.

lodging.name: The Jerome Grand Hotel
lodging.blurb: A (reputedly haunted) former hospital on the hill.

foodMustTry.name: Verde Valley wine
foodMustTry.blurb: Jerome's tasting rooms pour local vintages.

item.title: Jerome ghost town
item.blurb: Steep, twisting streets of galleries, saloons, and mining ruins, with views clear across the Verde Valley.

item.title: Jerome State Historic Park
item.blurb: The Douglas Mansion museum tells the copper-boom story.

days.label: Day 410 — Down to the Valley of the Sun
days.summary: Off the mountain into the desert.

commute.scenicNote: Down the switchbacks off Cleopatra Hill and south through Prescott and the Bradshaw Mountains — three thousand feet of descent, and the saguaros start where the pines stop.
